structured.answer: I'll ask my son, and maybe the bank, before I move anything. Harel has 105 products, mostly shares and "מט"ח". Fees run about half a percent ("0.41%" to "0.67%"), and the only track that looked safe to me, "כספי (שקלי)", shows about 4.25%–4.4% for 3 years. I can't tell if that beats my deposits.

stuck.where: Column 'תשואה שנתית ממוצעת לפני דמי ניהול'
stuck.why: Many rows say 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number. I didn't know if that means no results or a new track.
Both numbers in a row can be 99%, which adds up to more than 100. Didn't make sense to me.
Two fees per row, and some say 'אין' or 'עוד לא דווח'. I wasn't sure which one I'd actually pay.
Tired after six screens of dense rows that all looked the same. Stopped in the middle of 'קרן חדשה מקיפה'.

used: Header 'הראל' and 'כל המוצרים של הראל' with '105'
Group lines showing the fee range, e.g. 'דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.54% עד 0.61%'
Row 'כספי (שקלי)': 0.57% fee, 4.25% for 3 years (קופת גמל להשקעה) and 4.4% (קרן השתלמות)
Row group 'חיסכון לכל ילד' with 0.01% fee
The 'כסף מנוהל' amounts, to see that the tracks are big

The '?' icons and the arrows at the end of rows
Top menu: מדריך, חוקים וכללים, השוואה למטרה, השקעה במדד

findings.what: Dark background with light text, and small grey headings and notes that are hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: Whole page, especially column headers and the line under the title

findings.what: Opens with shares, 'מט"ח' and English letters 'S&P 500'. No safe or deposit option is pointed out
Too many numbers in every row, with two fees, two returns and two exposures
Exposure percentages add up to over 100% with no explanation
'פחות מ־3 שנים' in place of a return, with no explanation
The site's name 'מקור' is unknown to me, and it's not clear who is behind it
Only icons and question marks explain the terms. No plain sentence on what to choose
